en.name: Firewatcher
en.ability: Each night*, guess the distance between you and the first player to die tonight. If correct, all players except you cannot die tonight, but you may die.

revisions.v1: Each night*, guess the distance between you and the first player to die tonight. If correct, all players except you cannot die tonight, but you may die.

zh.name: 打更人
zh.ability: 每个夜晚*，你要猜测今晚首个死亡的玩家与你的距离。如果你猜测正确，则除你以外的所有玩家今晚不会死亡，但你可能会死亡。
